# Me, Myself & I Nails

> Nail art studio based in Pflugerville, Texas. Hand-painted characters, neon ombre, florals, drips and bling, painted freehand by artists who love a wild idea. Book your appointment and bring the vibe.

- Phone: (512) 291-2002
- Based in: Pflugerville, TX
- Nearby areas: Pflugerville, Round Rock, Hutto, Wells Branch, Manor
- Google rating: 4.7 from 102 reviews

- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/me-myself-and-i-nails/book.html

## Services
- Hand-painted nail art: Characters, bees, florals, drips and anything else you can dream up, painted freehand nail by nail.
- Acrylic sets, chrome & bling: Long, sharp and loud, or short and sweet. Sculpted sets finished with chrome, crystals and pearls.
- Gel, dip, manis & pedis: Clean, glossy color on natural nails or a full set, plus fills, French tips and pedicures.

## About
Me, Myself & I Nails is a nail studio in a little suite at 1101 W Pecan St in Pflugerville, built around the idea that nail art should be as personal as the name on the door. Clients come for the art: cartoon characters on every finger, honeybees and honeycomb, pastel florals, black drips and neon ombre stilettos loaded with crystals. Reviewers have walked out with Legend of Zelda engagement nails, freehand Halloween sets, chrome for a bachelorette and unicorns, so bring the idea or give the artists permission to have fun. Appointments come first so every set gets the time it deserves, and regulars say they're always on time. Some of the team also takes mobile appointments, so call ahead before you stop by. When you're here, there's a coffee and tea bar and a comfy lounge while you wait.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: We're appointment-first. Custom art takes time and some of our artists do mobile appointments, so please call (512) 291-2002 before you come in and we'll tell you if a chair is open.
- Q: Can you paint a specific character or design?
  A: Yes, that's our favorite thing. Clients have walked out with cartoon characters, unicorns, bees, florals and full Halloween sets. Bring a photo or describe the idea when you book.
- Q: Do you do manicures, pedicures and dip?
  A: Yes. Along with nail art and full sets we do gel polish, SNS dip, fill-ins, manicures and pedicures. Call to book.
- Q: Do you do mobile appointments?
  A: Some of our artists do. Call (512) 291-2002 to ask about availability and where we can travel.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 9 am to 5 pm, Saturday 10 am to 5 pm, closed Sunday.
- Q: Where is the studio?
  A: 1101 W Pecan St, Suite 3, Pflugerville, TX 78660.
